Unallocated Payment: payment that is not linked to an invoice

details:
def reconcile_project_financials(project_name):
    project = frappe.get_doc("RUA Project", project_name)
    invoices = frappe.get_all(
        "RUA Invoice",
        filters={
            "project": project_name,
            "status": "Final",
            "type": "Tax Invoice"
        },
        fields=["grand_total"]
    )
    calculated_total_invoiced = sum(frappe.utils.flt(inv.grand_total) for inv in invoices)
    payments = frappe.get_all(
        "RUA Payment",
        filters={
            "project": project_name,
            "status": "Submitted"
        },
        fields=["type", "amount"]
    )
    
    calculated_totals = {
        "project_cost": sum(frappe.utils.flt(p.amount) for p in payments if p.type == "Pay"),
        "additional_expenses": sum(frappe.utils.flt(p.amount) for p in payments if p.type == "Pay: Petty Cash"),
        "total_received": sum(frappe.utils.flt(p.amount) for p in payments if p.type == "Receive")
    }
    needs_update = False
    updates = []
    if frappe.utils.flt(project.total_invoiced) != frappe.utils.flt(calculated_total_invoiced):
        updates.append(f"total_invoiced: {project.total_invoiced} → {calculated_total_invoiced}")
        project.total_invoiced = calculated_total_invoiced
        needs_update = True
    current_project_cost = frappe.utils.flt(project.project_cost)
    current_additional_expenses = frappe.utils.flt(project.additional_expenses)
    current_total_received = frappe.utils.flt(project.total_received)
    if current_project_cost != calculated_totals["project_cost"]:
        updates.append(f"project_cost: {current_project_cost} → {calculated_totals['project_cost']}")
        project.project_cost = calculated_totals["project_cost"]
        needs_update = True
    if current_additional_expenses != calculated_totals["additional_expenses"]:
        updates.append(f"additional_expenses: {current_additional_expenses} → {calculated_totals['additional_expenses']}")
        project.additional_expenses = calculated_totals["additional_expenses"]
        needs_update = True
    if current_total_received != calculated_totals["total_received"]:
        updates.append(f"total_received: {current_total_received} → {calculated_totals['total_received']}")
        project.total_received = calculated_totals["total_received"]
        needs_update = True
    if needs_update:
        project.save(ignore_permissions=True)
        frappe.log_error(
            message=f"Project {project_name} updated:\n" + "\n".join(updates),
            title="Project Reconciliation"
        )
        
projects = frappe.get_all("RUA Project", pluck="name")
for project_name in projects:
    reconcile_project_financials(project_name)

details:
Complete revamp of invoices, payments and totals into one centralized method that triggers;

  • After updating the app (app-wide)
  • On creation/update/deletion of every invoice (project-specific)
  • On creation/update/deletion of every payment (project-specific)


The flow of operations is as the following;

  1. Updates project's total_invoiced
  2. Sums all invoices where:
  3. Status is 'Final'
  4. Type is 'Tax Invoice'
  5. Linked to the project
  6. Updates project's project_cost
  7. Sums all payments where:
  8. Status is 'Submitted'
  9. Type is 'Pay'
  10. Linked to the project
  11. Updates project's additional_expenses
  12. Sums all payments where:
  13. Status is 'Submitted'
  14. Type is 'Pay: Petty Cash'
  15. Linked to the project
  16. Updates project's total_received
  17. Sums all payments where:
  18. Status is 'Submitted'
  19. Type is 'Receive'
  20. Linked to the project
  21. Updates invoice's payment_status
  22. Sets to 'Paid' if total linked payments >= invoice amount
  23. Sets to 'Partially Paid' if some payments exist but less than invoice amount
  24. Sets to 'Unpaid' if no payments linked
  25. Updates invoice's payment_linked flag
  26. Sets to 1 if any payments are linked
  27. Sets to 0 if no payments linked
  28. Generates reconciliation summary counting:
  29. Total Projects
  30. Total Invoices
  31. Total Payments
  32. Paid Invoices
  33. Partially Paid Invoices
  34. Logs the summary in the error log for reference
name: h05m0i9m0u
title: Invoices, Payments & Totals
